title: Renderflow standalone screenplay import bundle v1
description: Completion receipt published last in a new output directory after an explicitly enabled native screenplay import. Retain both listed artifacts together with bundle.json.
$comment: JSON Schema cannot establish receipt publication order, file existence, byte lengths, digest equality, or that a provider ran. Consumers must verify both listed files, parse provider-evidence.json against renderflow-scripttool-evidence-v1.schema.json, and bind screenplay.fountain to that evidence's output_sha256. Completed means this bundle was published; it does not mean native provider qualification, complete fidelity, or native-application acceptance.

limits.const: A successful run validates only the adopted body profile and observed tool invocation; native application acceptance and complete screenplay fidelity remain unqualified.
